title: Laplace Analysis of Falling Object Motion and Stability
expert_review: A classic engineering problem that effectively links differential equations, Laplace transforms, and the physical interpretation of stability.
source: Classical Mechanics and Control Theory Exercises
learning_objectives: Solve a first-order ODE using Laplace transform techniques
Perform partial fraction expansion to return to the time domain
Construct transfer functions for different output variables (velocity vs position)
Distinguish between asymptotically stable and marginally stable systems based on pole locations
